unit.why: A homiletic-kabbalistic discourse (cited from ד״ש פ׳ בחקותי) on the spiritual nature of letters and on worldly distractions. Its only narrative element is a brief exemplum in which a man complains and the author answers him; this serves the teaching rather than standing as a story.
unit.boundary_note: part of a thematic anthology section on טרדות (distractions); the previous division ends a separate cited item, and the next division continues the same theme with a citation from נ״מ
